title: Ask instead of denying when the auto-mode classifier is unreachable
description: When the safety classifier cannot be reached, auto mode fails closed and denies the tool call outright. This turns that one branch into a permission prompt, so a transient classifier outage costs a confirmation rather than a blocked action. Every other deny — including an actual unsafe verdict — is untouched.

sites.description:
The fail-closed return inside the classifier-unavailable branch, logged as "denying with retry guidance (fail closed)". Six auto-mode denials share this shape; this is the only one whose message carries httpStatus and errorKind — diagnostics that exist precisely because no verdict was obtained — and the only one without noVerdict. Both tests are applied, since either alone would be one incidental property away from matching a real denial.

Not to be confused with the AskUserQuestion path a few lines above, which already falls back to the question dialog, or with the onBlock=="flag" path, which returns behavior:"allow" with a warning.
